notes: Food for home consumption is exempt.
Motor fuel is exempt from the general sales tax (per-gallon excise instead).
Tobacco is assumed taxed at the general rate (excise taxes left out); not verified state by state.
gaps: Local rate in each city is the most common among its address records; county taxes (Dakota County) are included.
Good Life district entries in the SST rate file are not tied to any current address in the boundary file, so any change to the state rate inside those districts is not reflected.
Local occupation taxes on restaurants and lodging (for example in Omaha) are not included.
